text:
Alex D: Heads-up — we need a quick decision on scoping for the compliance work in sprint 58. Customer asks: per-tenant BYOK + 7yr retention for financial pilot. Can we fit anything meaningful?

Priya R: Noted. Two main constraints: 1) KMS integration surface area (handshake, rotations, escrow), 2) retention storage cost + search SLA.

Elaine (PM): Proposal: run a priority matrix in this thread — axis A = customer impact, axis B = implementation risk/cost. We classify three candidate items: A) BYOK handshake + basic kafka-backed evidence export, B) 7yr cold retention tier (read-latency best-effort), C) per-tenant audit search (fast index).

Tom - Eng: Quick dev note: BYOK handshake MVP (no HSM escrow) is ~3w of eng + infra work for key material flow, plus 1w for e2e tests and canary. Search indexing for long-tail retention is the risky one — indexing cost spikes and query perf unknown.

Jordan - Security: For SOC2/ISO acceptance we need cryptographic proof of custody + access logs. BYOK helps business, but escrow/rotation policies are gating for enterprise legal. If we ship handshake without rotation guarantees, legal flags.

Alex D: Can we make a reduced-scope BYOK: customer uploads key, we store encrypted blob, runtime uses it for encrypting evidence, but we call out that rotation and escrow are "phase 2"? Customers ok with documented limitations?

Priya R: That reduced-scope maps to medium impact, low-medium risk. Good rollback behavior is important (ability to migrate keys off). Add to acceptance criteria: manual rotation path + documented constraints.

Elaine (PM): Let's capture acceptance criteria per candidate: 
- BYOK-MVP: customer key upload, per-tenant key pinning, manual rotation doc, no escrow, e2e audit logs.
- Cold-retention: TTL to cold store, retrieval within 24h Service Level for archived evidence.
- Fast-audit-search: indexed tail for last 2 years only, older data search fallback to cold retrieval (async).

Tom - Eng: From capacity side: 7yr retention at current ingestion estimates -> ~3.2x storage growth and +30% monthly cost. Need finance sign-off. Implementing cold tier sounds feasible if we limit hot index to 2 years.

Jordan - Security: For production rollout we require: canary in US region, monitoring for access anomalies, automated retention delete audit, and KMS audit log shipping to customer's SIEM.

Alex D: Action items: Elaine to own prioritization decision, Tom to estimate eng effort per item, Jordan to write security gating checklist, Priya to talk to top pilot customer re: phased BYOK. Deadline EOD Tuesday?

Elaine (PM): I will draft a simple prioritization matrix and vote. Quick poll: thumbs up for BYOK-MVP in Sprint 58, thumbs down to delay. Reply with :+1: or :-1:.

Tom - Eng: :+1: for BYOK-MVP (will start detailed tasks if approved).

Jordan - Security: :+1: only if we lock in the security gating checklist (I will post it here by tomorrow).

Priya R: :-1: on cold 7yr retention for sprint 58 (hold for finance + infra reprioritization).

Alex D: :+1: BYOK-MVP, defer full rotation/escrow. We should set a hard date for phase 2.

deploy-bot: scheduled-deploy | sprint-58-planning noted — create epic REDWOOD-CLI-8930 and assign to Elaine.

Elaine (PM): Thanks — I'll create the epic, add the matrix, and assign owners. Next sync: Wed 10am to resolve finance numbers and finalize launch gates.

Alex D: Perfect. One more ask — add a short customer communication draft that outlines limitations and roadmap phases. I'll take first pass.

Priya R: I'll schedule the pilot customer call after we have the matrix.

Tom - Eng: I'll post the rough task breakdown in the epic tonight.

Jordan - Security: I'll upload the gating checklist and minimal audit requirements before the Wed sync. :white_check_mark:

Elaine (PM): Closing this thread for now — will update epic and link back. Thanks everyone.
